items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I played Chris Kelly six years. My brother, John, was in the band, so we played bass.

ctx.x: Which band were you with then?

I was with my brother's band then. I had them. I was with Chris Kelly after that. But anyhow, I stayed with Chris Kelly after we stopped traveling, one, two, and all the different places. I played Chris Kelly six years. My brother, John, was in the band, so we played bass. We played together. Six years. And we went to Tallulah. And stayed up there for months. That was our headquarters. We played around different places.
